authorization: User approved scripted previews and requested primitive training for 2000 updates.
initialization: fresh random initialization for each seed
parallelism_policy: Start two seeds, then increase to three after measured GPU memory permits.
look_success: target center within 7 degrees continuously for 1.5 seconds; displacement <=0.3m
scope: primitive training and final primitive validation
training_metric_denominator: successes + failures + interruptions for episodes used by PPO; exclude unfinished episodes and discarded surplus transitions
